cards.title: Should we move closer to family before school?
cards.body: A parent seeks advice on relocating near family before their daughter starts school. While stronger friendships take time to build, returning home comes with its own costs beyond finances.

cards.title: My son's back home after graduation
cards.body: A mother navigates having her adult son return to the nest due to economic pressures. She humorously reflects on how her mothering skills change when her child moves back in.

cards.title: Can parents leave family to live in wilderness?
cards.body: A columnist questions whether it's acceptable for parents with small children to pursue extreme adventures like wilderness survival competitions. She explores the ethical tension between personal fulfillment and parental responsibility.

cards.title: Answer to ending sexual violence starts in childhood
cards.body: Research indicates that preventing sexual violence requires intervention and education beginning in childhood. Early prevention strategies are key to addressing this critical public health issue.

cards.title: The impact of a psychopathic mother
cards.body: Psychopathic mothers can emotionally and psychologically abuse their children through displays of lovelessness and guilt-free behavior. This parenting dynamic often involves creating division and confusion within the family.

cards.title: Youth mental health in global decline
cards.body: Recent research shows that young people's mental health and wellbeing are declining worldwide. The demographic is increasingly turning to AI therapy as a coping mechanism.

cards.title: Horses help children learn emotion regulation
cards.body: Horses can mirror human emotions, helping people identify and understand their feelings in the moment. This equine-assisted therapy motivates individuals to develop better emotional control.

cards.title: Grooming laws need clearer definition
cards.body: Campaigners are calling for legislation that clearly defines what grooming means. Better legal clarity can help protect children from manipulation and abuse.
